title: Support Brotli Large Window (RFC 9841)?
body:
### What is the issue with the Compression Standard?

https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9841

I'm not sure the google brotli library is even ready for this, since it [does not support](https://searchfox.org/firefox-main/rev/2c35ff84ed7d1ca088a41f830bfab0be50868536/modules/brotli/common/constants.h#50-55) [the full allowed wbits range](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9841#section-6) and I don't see the framing format support. (The dictionary part is not relevant as this spec don't support custom dictionaries at all.)

I'm filing this because I had a feature request to match https://pdfium-review.googlesource.com/c/pdfium/+/155710 but I'm hesitant to just flip the flag on brotli decoder on Firefox. So right now this is just a placeholder for something we could do in the future.

Currently the Compression spec declines whatever is not RFC 7932 compliant:

> Non-[[RFC7932]](https://compression.spec.whatwg.org/#biblio-rfc7932)-conforming blocks must not be created by [CompressionStream](https://compression.spec.whatwg.org/#compressionstream), and are errors for [DecompressionStream](https://compression.spec.whatwg.org/#decompressionstream).
